The font metric data bundled by @pdf-lib/standard-fonts 1.0.0 originates from AFM files. Upstream converted the AFM data to JSON and compressed it, as stated in the package README. This distribution preserves upstream compiled data unchanged; this application only copies existing PDF pages and does not create or distribute new font programs. Original metric copyright/trademark notices are preserved in standard-font-metric-notices.json. No local test font programs or synthetic PDF fixtures are distributed here.
